---
title: "JustifyPassVelo"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
full_df <- read.csv("full_data.csv")
```

```{r}
pass_velo <- full_df %>% 
  filter(phase == "pre_pass", player_role == "Passer") %>% 
  group_by(play_id, game_id) %>% 
  filter(frame_id == max(frame_id)) %>% 
  mutate(throw_time = num_frames_output/10,
         throw_dist = sqrt((x-ball_land_x)^2 + (y-ball_land_y)^2)) %>% 
  summarize(throw_speed = throw_dist/throw_time) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarize(
    p05_speed = quantile(throw_speed, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95_speed = quantile(throw_speed, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
